nodes.label: Towards Scalable and Versatile Weight Space Learning (SANE)
nodes.author: Konstantin Schurholt, Michael W. Mahoney, Damian Borth

nodes.label: SANE: Sequential Autoencoder for Neural Embeddings
nodes.rationale: SANE overcomes prior hyper-representation limits by tokenizing model weights layer-by-layer and encoding subsequences (windows) rather than the full flattened weight vector; decouples tokenization from representation learning, enabling embeddings of much larger and architecturally varying NNs. Uses contrastive guidance and reconstruction loss, with haloing and batch-norm conditioning for stability.

nodes.label: Hyper-Representations for Neural Network Weight Spaces
nodes.author: Schurholt et al. 2021; 2022a
nodes.rationale: Hyper-representations learn a lower-dimensional embedding z from populations of trained NN models via an encoder-decoder architecture trained with reconstruction and contrastive loss. Prior work was limited to models of fixed size/architecture.

nodes.label: Model Zoo Datasets for Weight Space Learning
nodes.rationale: SANE uses model zoos: CNN zoos (MNIST, SVHN, CIFAR-10, STL-10 with ~2.5k-12k params) and ResNet-18 zoos (CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet with ~12M params); ResNet zoos are 3 orders of magnitude larger than all prior hyper-representation model zoos.

nodes.label: WeightWatcher Weight Analysis Metrics
nodes.author: Martin et al., 2021
nodes.rationale: WW metrics include log spectral norm log(||W||_inf) and weighted alpha (power law fit to empirical spectral density); used to validate that SANE embeddings capture similar global model quality signals.
